procedure.step.COLLECT_REQUIREMENTS.inst: Open each item below and attach the file, fill in the details or confirm the action.
Documents must be scanned PDFs that are legible and complete; the text is extracted so it can be checked.
Items issued by another agency (e.g. a fiscal identifier) must be obtained there first; this step cannot replace them.
procedure.step.PREVALIDATION.instruction: Reopen every item and compare it with the official data: names, identifiers, dates and signatures must match exactly.
Mark an item Valid only once you have checked it; mark it Invalid to flag what must be redone.
Inconsistent data is the first cause of rejection and delays the agencies that depend on this file.
procedure.step.AUTHENTICATION.instructio: The official channel identifies you with a certificate or account; without it the submission cannot be made.
Check the certificate is active and not expired, and that it is issued to the right person or company.
Getting a certificate or activating an account can take days and may require an in-person step: start early.
procedure.step.READY_FOR_SUBMISSION.inst: Every requirement is valid. Go through the self-check questions one last time.
Prepare the files in the format the channel expects and keep the originals at hand.
procedure.step.OFFICIAL_SUBMISSION.instr: Submit on the official channel yourself. This app prepares the file but never submits it on your behalf.
Keep the receipt or acknowledgement number, then record the submission on the Submission page.
The agency checks completeness and consistency. Reply quickly to any request for correction.
Record the outcome here: accepted, or rejected with the reason, so the checklist can be fixed.

procedure.requirement.VALIDATED_STATUTES: Company statutes as validated at constitution (APII chain). Needed as the legal basis of the registration.
procedure.requirement.REGISTERED_STATUTE: Statutes bearing the registration stamp of the court registry (Greffe).
procedure.requirement.MANAGER_BENEFICIAR: Full identity of the manager(s) and of every beneficial owner: name, ID number, address, share held.
The tax number issued by the DGI after the existence declaration. Obtain it first if you do not have it.
procedure.requirement.RNE_OR_RC_INFORMAT: The RNE identifier, or the commercial register number and the registry that issued it.
procedure.requirement.MANAGER_CIN.hint: Copy of the manager’s national identity card, both sides, in date.
procedure.requirement.MONTHLY_TAX_DECLAR: Turnover, VAT collected and deductible, withholdings and other taxes for the month.
procedure.requirement.TAXPAYER_ENROLLMEN: Enrollment of the company as an online filer with the DGI (e-Jibaya).
procedure.requirement.TAXPAYER_IDENTIFIE: The identifier given at enrollment; it is used to log in and file.
procedure.requirement.DIGIGO_CERTIFICATE: Electronic certificate issued by TunTrust (DigiGo). Check it is active and in the right name.
procedure.requirement.ANNUAL_RESULTS_TAX: Balance sheet, income statement and annexes for the financial year, in the e-Liasse format.
procedure.requirement.QUALIFIED_TUNTRUST: Qualified electronic signature from TunTrust; legally equivalent to a handwritten signature.
procedure.requirement.TEJ_ENROLLMENT.hin: Enrollment on the TEJ portal to consult the tax situation.
procedure.requirement.TEJ_LOGIN_CERTIFIC: Login credentials plus the electronic certificate used to access TEJ.
procedure.requirement.RNE_UPDATE_SUPPORT: Documents proving the change: new address, appointment minutes, activity change… Only if your update needs them.
procedure.requirement.RNE_DEREGISTRATION: Scanned dissolution acts and supporting documents, electronically signed.
procedure.requirement.RNE_ELECTRONIC_ACT: Acts, minutes or statutes you want to store as certified electronic documents.
procedure.requirement.RNE_E_SAFE_ACTIVAT: One-time activation of the safe, often done in person at the RNE.
procedure.requirement.OTP.hint: One-time code sent during activation or sensitive operations.
